question: Can I activate outlast on a creature that came under my control this turn?

expected.shortAnswer: No: outlast includes the tap symbol, so the creature must have been under your control since the beginning of your turn.
expected.answer: The cost to activate a creature's outlast ability includes the tap symbol ({T}). A creature's outlast ability can't be activated unless that creature has been under your control continuously since the beginning of your turn.

whyHard: Outlast looks like a simple counter-adding ability, so players forget that tap costs carry the summoning-sickness restriction.
